records.title: 10-Q
records.text: (1) The tax benefit (expense) included in foreign currency translation adjustments and pension and postretirement adjustments for the three and six months ended June 30, 2023 and June 30, 2022 was immaterial.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue recognized during the three and six months ended June 30, 2023 included in the contract liabilities balance as of January 1, 2023 was approximately $58 million and $147 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Revenue recognized during the three and six months ended June 30, 2022 included in the contract liabilities balance as of January 1, 2022 was approximately $56 million and $135 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total intangible amortization expense for the six months ended June 30, 2023 was $33 million, as compared to $28 million in the comparable prior year period.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The estimated fair value amounts were determined by the Corporation using available market information that is primarily based on quoted market prices for the same or similar issuances as of June 30, 2023.
